say:2:1810320001:0.text: The girl lets out a feeble groan, clearly in immense pain.
say:2:1810320001:0.source_cn: 女孩发出了微弱的呻吟，似乎正遭受着极大的痛苦。

say:3:1810320002:1.text: What's going on? Your purification magic should have been able to remove all the flowers, but now, only the ones on the surface are gone.
say:3:1810320002:1.source_cn: 但是，这怎么可能？你的净化魔法原本该能将她身上的赤烛蕊...
say:3:1810320002:1.male: What's going on? Your purification magic should have been able to remove all the flowers, but now, only the ones on the surface are gone.
say:3:1810320002:1.female: What's going on? Your purification magic should have been able to remove all the flowers, but now, only the ones on the surface are gone.

say:4:1810320003:1.text: Maybe becoming a Graveborn has suppressed your mana. Muttering a few curses at the God of Death, you gather the mana scattered around you and cast the spell again.
say:4:1810320003:1.source_cn: 或许是亡灵状态压制了你的魔力流动，你一边在心中暗暗骂人...
say:4:1810320003:1.male: Maybe becoming a Graveborn has suppressed your mana. Muttering a few curses at the God of Death, you gather the mana scattered around you and cast the spell again.
say:4:1810320003:1.female: Maybe becoming a Graveborn has suppressed your mana. Muttering a few curses at the God of Death, you gather the mana scattered around you and cast the spell again.

say:5:1810320004:1.text: The next instant, a ferocious roar erupts in the distance, followed by rapidly approaching footsteps...
say:5:1810320004:1.source_cn: 然而就在此刻，你忽然听到远处传来一声愤怒的嘶吼，一阵猛...
